thesis: ACHC is in a clean uptrend after a post-earnings gap, and it has held the gap for about two weeks in a tight consolidation just under its 52-week high. Revenue growth is stable, net income is recovering sequentially and free cash flow is positive. The stock is a health care name, and health care is one of the defensive areas holding up in a risk-off tape. Short interest near a third of float adds squeeze fuel if 39.7 breaks on volume. This is still a modest setup. Reward/risk is about 1.5, the stock is near consensus target, the gap driver is undocumented, and the regime is hostile. The case only works as a pullback entry in the 36.9-37.9 zone, not as a chase at the 38.44 pre-market price.
